prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: editorial cover thumbnail for a Chinese Juejin Android developer article; landscape 3:2, 1536x1024.
Primary request: Create a polished, restrained technology editorial cover about Google Play one-time in-app purchases and permanently unlocking Pro features.
Subject: a large elegant smartphone silhouette with an open padlock and small checkmark integrated into a simple purchase card. Communicate payment completed and permanent unlock. Clean dimensional illustration, professional rather than playful, generous negative space.
Composition: clear hierarchy readable even as a 192x128 thumbnail; one compact illustration and prominent typography, safe margins at least 10%, no tiny decorative detail.
Text (verbatim): "Google Play" and "一次性内购". Google Play is the small heading; 一次性内购 is the dominant large Chinese title in accurate clean bold sans-serif.
Constraints: only these two text lines. No code, price, currency, app-specific identity, screenshots, invented badges, slogans, watermarks, Android character, or extra logos. No misleading official endorsement. Avoid busy gradients and excessive glow.
